what: While a clock dial larger than the screen passes through the pinned section (default 600vh), it rises from 1.5 screens below at ×max(2, screen×2.5/ring) to the center at ×1. It draws an accent-color border and 221 ticks (each tick spans 3.5 cells, outer→inner) clockwise from the bottom, by the amount .25+.75×progress. The hand makes a half turn from the bottom (180°) to the top (360°). Past .75 it draws a two-digit number outline, fills it once complete, then counts down one step per second (the hand turns 1/value of a revolution each step). The hand is a spring (speed += Follows along by gap×.26, ×.32)

options.value: Starting value to count down from, default 26
options.start: Draw amount at which the number outline starts drawing (0~1), default .75
options.--fx-ring: Ring diameter (CSS variable), default max(1400px, min(1800px, 98vw))
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Text slot (child, optional) that follows below the number — at 78% of ring height
